title: Advancing a saturated input position
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and every natural number $j$, moving the input head one cell to the right from the saturated position $\min(j,|w|)+1$ gives the saturated position $\min(j+1,|w|)+1$.
replaced:
For every input $w$ and every count $j$, moving the input head one cell to
the right from the saturated position for $j$ on $w$ yields the saturated
position for $j+1$.
